current_revision.architecture: Durable Cloudflare Queue with real tool-calling merchant agents
current_revision.question_transport: Immediate pending envelope, followed by explicit status-link polling
current_revision.job_storage: Private existing D1 state; 30-minute TTL; tenant-scoped opaque token
current_revision.required_live_evidence: One completed production job whose actual model usage.calls is greater than zero
current_revision.prior_evidence_notice: Earlier template/rule and synchronous browser/native results below are historical evidence and do not prove this strict real-LLM revision.

live_model_proof.scenario: White roses as a thank-you gift to Besiktas tomorrow, within 800 TRY; preserve the card message and answer vase-fee and replacement-policy questions.
live_model_proof.evidence: The final public GPT-6 Luna job returned a real generated answer and eligible 710 TRY quote. Ten provider calls and four independently checked claims were verified. Checkout and the human product page showed 710 TRY and the correct saved note, both as visible server-rendered text and a prefilled input. No order was placed.
live_model_proof.timing_scope: Includes browser operations; not measured server latency or a guaranteed completion time

model_change.status: Verified in production and native ChatGPT

deployment.platform: Cloudflare Pages proxy and Cloudflare Worker
deployment.scope: Final verified GPT-6 Luna durable real-agent revision

homepage.evidence: The fresh production document rendered AskAgent — Protocol v0.1 and the Test this scenario section. The production screenshot was updated after the final deployment.

public_example_get.evidence: The complete production GET chain worked in the in-app browser: published example question, returned Continue link, verified quote, and checkout envelope. The saved card message persisted and the quote total was 1,370 TRY. This browser result is separate from native ChatGPT compatibility.

merchant_comparison.evidence: The production browser playground returned three independent catalog-backed outcomes for the same 25-red-rose request.

outcomes.reason: Red roses are out of stock; pink roses are an alternative

conversation_continuity.evidence: The production merchant page preserved the follow-up card message and the original stem count, budget, delivery district, and deadline.

quote.evidence: The server-rendered product handoff showed the saved selection and delivery-inclusive quote using a merchant link from the source evidence.

human_handoff.evidence: A direct merchant product link with the session handle rendered the prepared selection; client JavaScript then removed the handle from the address bar. The old playground action was bypassed because of its JSON-negotiation bug.

simulated_order.evidence: With fictional recipient/address inputs and the confirmation checkbox selected, Create Demo Order returned a confirmation displaying the correct total, delivery, and no-payment notice.
simulated_order.idempotency: Not repeated in the production browser; covered by the local HTTP smoke test.

final_html_question.timing_scope: Observed browser navigation duration, not measured server latency
final_html_question.evidence: The fresh published HTML question link preserved the explicit 25-stem requirement, rejected GB15R, and displayed only the eligible 25-red-rose response at 1,370 TRY.

prepared_order_fix.change: Programmatic quote and checkout GETs explicitly request format=json and Accept: application/json. Human-facing protocol links retain their default representation.
prepared_order_fix.production_retest: Playground button retest pending; direct merchant handoff has passed

native_fetch_latency_fix.change: All model stages share one default 7000 ms deadline; later stages use the remaining time or return the existing honest provider fallback.
native_fetch_latency_fix.validation: The focused mocked-provider test and npm run typecheck passed.
native_fetch_latency_fix.production_retest: Fresh browser HTML question GET passed with honest fallback; the final native ChatGPT question test is pending.
native_fetch_latency_fix.superseded_by: Durable async real-agent jobs without an arbitrary overall model deadline

homepage.surface: Codex in-app browser, local mobile viewport
homepage.evidence: The English protocol-document homepage fits the viewport without horizontal overflow, omits the previous hero/shop/playground/activity sections, and retains the canonical-origin native ChatGPT prompt CTA.
homepage.production_retest: Passed on production desktop; production mobile was not separately checked

automated_http_smoke.evidence: Node fetch, Python urllib, and bounded IPv4 curl could resolve the production domain but received TLS connection resets before an HTTP response. No simulated order was created by these attempts.

native_chatgpt.surface: Native ChatGPT browser conversations inspected by the root agent

storefront_catalog_comparison.evidence: ChatGPT read the storefront pages and compared their public catalog itself: 25 red roses at 1,370 TRY for today at 19:30, 20 red roses at 1,270 TRY for tomorrow, and a shop without red-rose stock. ChatGPT explicitly said the website's agent did not answer; this is not evidence of a completed AskAgent conversation.

agent_discovery.evidence: ChatGPT's web tool could read all three merchant AskAgent discovery endpoints.

dynamic_agent_question.evidence: The latest native ChatGPT request to the exact HTML question URL received the real merchant-agent HTTP 200 response and a conversation handle. No raw handle is stored in this evidence.

dynamic_order_preparation.evidence: The real question, continuation, catalog evidence, and quote succeeded. Checkout still returned request a quote first despite the verified quote; its deterministic self-verification fix awaits deployment.

card_message_continuity.evidence: Native ChatGPT followed the returned continuation and verified that the card message persisted.

session_checkout.evidence: Checkout was reachable but returned request a quote first; the final human handoff from native ChatGPT is not yet verified.

native_chatgpt.latest_revision_evidence: Native ChatGPT received the actual merchant-agent answer, conversation handle, continued card message, catalog evidence, and 1,370 TRY quote. Checkout remains the unfinished last step.
native_chatgpt.web_tool_homepage_freshness: An older homepage was observed; production in-app browser showed the revised document.

catalog_evidence.evidence: Native ChatGPT verified returned catalog evidence, stock, and today-at-19:30 delivery.

quote.evidence: Native ChatGPT verified the source-backed deterministic quote.

current_async_revision.evidence: Native ChatGPT retrieved the final Luna answer at polling attempt 8, verified its ten actual model calls and independent referee pass, and followed checkout to the actual 710 TRY product page with the correct visible saved note. IAB separately confirmed that the input was prefilled correctly. No order was placed.

card_message_readability.evidence: The correct saved note is visible as server-rendered text read by native ChatGPT; the in-app browser also confirmed the actual input value.

checkout_self_verification_fix.change: GET checkout verifies a known SKU against saved delivery zone and current requirements, persists a deterministic quote, and returns the human handoff without creating an order. Quote-response checkout URLs carry quote_id to distinguish earlier retrieved responses.
checkout_self_verification_fix.production_retest: Checkout and product handoff passed in the final IAB and native ChatGPT flow
